message.content: According to the discussions provided, LiHua expresses strong positive opinions about the graphics and gameplay of Black Myth: Wukong. Specifically, LiHua mentions that the visuals are "stunning" and that the world design is "so immersive." Additionally, LiHua describes the gameplay as "fresh and exciting," indicating that the game offers innovative and engaging elements. LiHua also highlights the game's ability to offer both action and strategic thinking, making every session feel different and satisfying. Overall, LiHua seems to be thoroughly impressed with the visual aesthetics and the multifaceted gameplay mechanics of the game.
